title: Humanoid Bee Model & Quark LGBT Compat
description: A small resource pack created to add compatibility between 3XH6R's Humanoid Bee Model and Quark's LGBT Bee Animal Variants option.
body:
Me and a friend love using the Resource Pack called [Humanoid Bee Model](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/humanoid-bee-model) by 3XH6R. However, when using Vazkii's [Quark](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark) with the Animal Varients _LGBT Bees_ option on, it breaks (of hopefully obvious reasons).

So... Over the last few days, I have made a small resource pack in order to fix the issue! So now we can have all our favorite Bee Girls (and a few boys) in LGBeeTQ+ wear!
![All the Bees in their full Pride wear~](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03be184300d2574002718629b95383848228486b_0.webp)


This pack needs to be loaded **_after_** the original pack for it to work!
![Important Load Order Info](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7e91aa5d87c170b0f0c573e34cae191f903a983.png)

This resource pack requires the following to work:
- The original [Humanoid Bee Model](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/humanoid-bee-model) resource pack 3XH6R.
  - Optifine or [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) (personally, I recommend the second one~♥) 
- [Quark](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark) by Vazkii
